design.scale_rule: WGS84 bounds matched; 1200×900; geometry controls for hosted where possible
design.path_metric: route returned, geometry support, and end-to-reference offsets separately; independent truth needed

judgment: CLEAR_PRACTICAL_ADVANTAGE only if repeated material difference with common task/independent evidence or practical service blocker; INCONCLUSIVE if material input truth or evidence unresolved; otherwise NO_DECISIVE_DIFFERENCE; keep both in latter two
